title: Kong centers its 2026 strategy on AI connectivity
summary: The strategy reinforces Kong's position as a control layer for APIs and AI traffic, but it does not supply the audited growth, margin, retention, or share-count evidence needed for a valuation upgrade.
confirmed: Kong described AI connectivity, large-enterprise adoption, organizational expansion, and regional investment as strategic priorities.
uncertain: Revenue contribution, adoption rates, growth, and margin effects were not disclosed.
